echo_sets.name: Dream of the Lost
echo_sets.note: The game's first 3-piece set. Holding 0 Resonance Energy grants 20% Crit Rate and 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus. Her max energy is permanently 0, so the bonus is always on — this set was made for her. Nightmare: Hecate in the main slot adds 12% Havoc DMG and 20% Echo Skill DMG. Add a 2-piece Havoc set (Midnight Veil or Havoc Eclipse) for +10% Havoc DMG.

echo_sets.name: Havoc Eclipse
echo_sets.note: A starter option with Nightmare: Crownless as the main echo. Swap to the 3-piece Dream of the Lost + 2-piece Havoc setup once you have farmed it.

build.energy_regen_target: Not needed. Phrolova has 0 max Resonance Energy, so Energy Regen gives her nothing.
build.fast_path: Phrolova is a 5-star Havoc Rectifier carry. Her puppet Hecate deals Echo Skill DMG from off-field. Her max Resonance Energy is permanently 0, so the 3-piece Dream of the Lost set (20% Crit Rate, 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus) is always fully active. Use Nightmare: Hecate as the main echo and add a 2-piece Havoc set. Her signature Lethean Elegy is strongly recommended — it beats Stringmaster by roughly 17%. Run Crit DMG on Cost 4, Havoc DMG on both Cost 3, and ATK% on both Cost 1. Skip Energy Regen — she cannot hold Resonance Energy.

ranked_weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature Rectifier (587 ATK, 24.3% Crit Rate). After she deals Echo Skill DMG, she gains +32% Resonance Skill DMG, +32% Echo Skill DMG Amplification, and 8% DEF ignore. That covers both of her damage types. It deals ~100% relative damage, against 82.9% for Stringmaster. She is the team's main damage dealer, so get her signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: The best fallback, at ~82.9% relative damage. It can reach ~86% if you trim 10% Crit Rate from the build, since its main stat is Crit Rate. It gives Crit Rate, ATK, and 12% Havoc DMG Bonus. The ATK matters less during Maestro, where she already gains +120% ATK.

ranked_weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
ranked_weapons.note: ~82.7% relative damage. The ATK and Crit DMG help. Its Basic Attack passive is mostly wasted, though — Basic Attacks are only ~5% of her damage — and its effect ends early when she swaps out.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: ~77% relative damage. The ATK is usable and the Crit DMG is high. The Basic Attack passive gives her little, though.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: A free standard-banner option for a starter build. Pair it with Crownless echoes until you move to Dream of the Lost.

stat_priorities.note: Her signature gives 24.3% Crit Rate. Use a Crit Rate 4-cost if your weapon is a Crit DMG one, or if the build is short on Crit. Build target: Crit Rate 74-78%, Crit DMG 270-275%.
Two Havoc pieces beat ATK/Havoc (100% vs ~96.9% relative damage). Only run ATK%/Havoc if its substats are much better. Build target: ATK 2150-2250 with Havoc/Havoc, or 2400-2560 with ATK/Havoc.

profile.role_note: She summons Hecate. Her Liberation orders Hecate to fight for 24s, dealing Echo Skill DMG from off-field even while Phrolova is swapped out. Her Outro gives the next Resonator 20% Havoc DMG and 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Phrolova is still a top-tier Havoc carry in October 2026 tier lists (SS on Beebom's Version 3.7 list). Her signature weapon beats Stringmaster by a real ~17%, so budget for both on her next rerun. Her last known rerun was Version 2.8, so expect a longer wait. Pull her if you need a Havoc main DPS, or if you already own Cantarella or Qiuyuan. Skip her if your Havoc or off-field damage slot is already filled.

teams.name: Premium: Phrolova + Cantarella + Roccia

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: The burst carry; deals most of her damage off-field through Hecate, freeing the team's field time.

members.name: Cantarella
members.note: Casts Echo Skills and coordinated jellyfish attacks. Her Outro buffs Havoc and Resonance Skill DMG, and she heals the team.

members.name: Roccia
members.note: Boosts Havoc damage and controls crowds. She completes the strongest Havoc Echo Skill team.

teams.note: Her signature Havoc Echo Skill team — the one community guides rate highest. Cantarella and Roccia boost Echo Skill and Havoc damage while Hecate works from off-field.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Hypercarry; summons Hecate in Maestro, which keeps dealing off-field Echo Skill DMG for up to 24s.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Havoc Bane support for Negative Status teams; her Havoc buffs slot into Phrolova teams per community guides.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: A Crit buffer for any team, with strong healing across the whole field. Built for safer, survival-first clears.

teams.name: Alternative: Phrolova + Chisa + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Start with Phrolova. Chain Basic Attack Stage 3 and her Resonance Skill to build 6 Volatile Notes. Then cast Scarlet Coda and Resonance Liberation to enter Maestro. Swap to Shorekeeper for her Liberation and Crit field. Then swap to Chisa for Havoc Bane stacks. Chisa's Echo Skills feed Hecate's enhanced attacks from off-field, up to 10 triggers per Maestro. Shorekeeper's Outro brings back a fully buffed Phrolova for the next loop.
teams.note: A survivability-first variant: Chisa adds Havoc Bane support and Shorekeeper brings team-wide Crit buffs and healing, at a lower damage ceiling than the Cantarella + Roccia comp.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Still the damage core; off-field Hecate means she does not need much field time.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Free 4-star quick-swap sub-DPS; generates Concerto fast with minimal field time.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer and buffer; her Outro deepens the whole team's damage.

teams.name: Budget: Phrolova + Sanhua + Verina
teams.rotation: Sanhua quick-swaps in to fill Concerto and hand over her buffs. Then Verina uses her Liberation and Outro. Phrolova enters on Intro and builds 6 Volatile Notes. She casts Scarlet Coda into her Liberation (Maestro), then swaps out. Her teammates' Echo Skills keep triggering Hecate's enhanced attacks while Verina keeps the team alive.

teams_meta.note: Her standard partners are Cantarella and Roccia — the Havoc Echo Skill team shown across community guides (Game8 rates it S-tier for Cantarella). Chisa + Shorekeeper is the safer variant. Sanhua + Verina is the free-to-play fallback.
